title: Anomalous craft show interest in White Sands and Los Alamos
place_text: White Sands and Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: more to say about the general interest displayed in White Sands and nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory by uh by uh anomalous technologies.

plain: A former Pentagon official turned whistleblower named Matthew Brown says unexplained craft have shown a "general interest" in White Sands, the New Mexico missile test range, and nearby Los Alamos National Laboratory, where the atomic bomb was built. He says it on the show and hints he has "more to say"; if true, it would mean the craft are watching America's weapons sites.
